inspected_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical proposal file map this result inspected. Binds the verdict to exact content; author_state refuses a checkpoint whose preview digest differs.

findings.description: Structured findings this worker returned. An empty array means the worker checked and found nothing; absence of the field means the worker does not check.

template_gaps.description: Structured template gaps this worker returned, kept distinct from findings so a gap is never counted as a rule violation or silently dropped.

description: One worker's returned result. `findings` and `inspected_digest` are the authoritative record of a checking worker's verdict: author_state reads findings from the run's hash-chained mailbox through validation_evidence.py, never from a caller-supplied file, so a coordinator cannot substitute an empty list for a real failing result. Both are optional because only checking workers produce them.
